premise: Butterfly looks for something sweet and tastes by landing: on Deer's head (grassy), on Mushroom's cap (mossy), at last on Flower — sweet! — because butterflies taste with their feet.
inspiration: Goldilocks' three tries (folk), turned: too grassy, too mossy, just right — and Deer, trying it her way, goes back to his own.
lesson: Everyone has their own way of finding what they like.

en-US.title: Butterfly Tastes with Her Feet
en-US.text: {butterfly:enter} Butterfly was looking for something sweet. [curious] How does a butterfly know if a thing is sweet? Easy. She lands on it! {deer:enter} Deer was in the meadow nearby, {deer:live graze} nibbling the grass. {butterfly:go on deer} Down {sfx:flutter} fluttered Butterfly, right onto his head. {deer:face surprised} Tip, tip went her feet. {butterfly:face sad} "Hmm. Grassy. Not sweet." Up popped a red {mushroom:enter} mushroom. {butterfly:go on mushroom} Butterfly landed on her cap. Tip, tip. "Hmm. Mossy. Not sweet." {mushroom:live laugh} [giggles] "That tickles!" said Mushroom. And there, opening up, was a yellow {flower:enter} flower. {butterfly:go on flower} Butterfly landed right in the middle. Tip, tip… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:sparkle} [excited] {sfx:sip} "SWEET!" {deer:face normal} {deer:pulse} "How do you know?" asked Deer. [whispers] "I tasted it," said Butterfly, "with my feet." {deer:face surprised} So Deer {deer:live tap-hoof} tapped the grass with his hoof. Tip, tip. Nothing at all. {deer:face happy} So he {deer:live graze} nibbled it the usual way. "Mmm," he said. "Grassy. Just how I like it." {butterfly:live rest hold} And Butterfly folded her wings on Flower, {flower:face happy} {flower:hearts} sweet as can be.

es-ES.title: Las patitas de Mariposa
es-ES.text: {butterfly:enter} Mariposa andaba buscando algo dulce. [curious] ¿Y cómo sabe una mariposa si algo es dulce? Muy fácil: ¡se posa encima! {deer:enter} Ciervo estaba allí cerca, en el prado, {deer:live graze} mordisqueando hierba. {butterfly:go on deer} Mariposa bajó {sfx:flutter} revoloteando y se le posó en la cabeza. {deer:face surprised} Tip, tip, hicieron sus patitas. {butterfly:face sad} —Mmm. Sabe a hierba. No es dulce. Asomó una {mushroom:enter} seta roja. {butterfly:go on mushroom} Mariposa se posó en su sombrero. Tip, tip. —Mmm. Sabe a musgo. Tampoco. {mushroom:live laugh} [giggles] —¡Ay, qué cosquillas! —dijo Seta. Y allí, abriéndose despacito, había una {flower:enter} flor amarilla. {butterfly:go on flower} Mariposa se posó justo en el centro. Tip, tip… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:sparkle} [excited] {sfx:sip} —¡DULCE! {deer:face normal} {deer:pulse} —¿Y tú cómo lo sabes? —preguntó Ciervo. [whispers] —Porque lo he probado —dijo Mariposa—. Con las patitas. {deer:face surprised} Así que Ciervo {deer:live tap-hoof} tocó la hierba con la pezuña. Tip, tip. Nada de nada. {deer:face happy} Y la {deer:live graze} mordisqueó como siempre. —Mmm —dijo—. Sabe a hierba. Como a mí me gusta. {butterfly:live rest hold} Y Mariposa plegó las alas sobre Flor, {flower:face happy} {flower:hearts} dulce, dulcísima.

ja-JP.title: チョウチョさんは 足で あじみ
ja-JP.text: {butterfly:enter}チョウチョさんは、あまいものをさがしていました。[curious]あまいかどうか、チョウチョはどうやってわかるのでしょう？かんたん。とまってみるのです！{deer:enter}子ジカが、ちかくのはらっぱで{deer:live graze}くさをもぐもぐ。{butterfly:go on deer}チョウチョさんは{sfx:flutter}ひらひらおりて、子ジカのあたまにちょこん。{deer:face surprised}足で、ちょん、ちょん。{butterfly:face sad}「うーん。くさのあじ。あまくない。」 ひょっこり、赤い{mushroom:enter}キノコ。{butterfly:go on mushroom}かさにとまって、ちょん、ちょん。「うーん。コケのあじ。あまくない。」 {mushroom:live laugh}[giggles]「くすぐったい！」 とキノコ。すると、きいろい{flower:enter}お花がひらいていました。{butterfly:go on flower}まんなかにとまって、ちょん、ちょん…{butterfly:face happy}{butterfly:sparkle}[excited]{sfx:sip}「あまーい！」 {deer:face normal}{deer:pulse}「どうしてわかるの？」 と子ジカ。[whispers]「あじみしたの。足でね。」 {deer:face surprised}そこで子ジカも、{deer:live tap-hoof}ひづめでくさを、ちょん、ちょん。なんのあじもしません。{deer:face happy}だから、{deer:live graze}いつものように、もぐもぐ。「うん。くさのあじ。これがいちばん。」 {butterfly:live rest hold}チョウチョさんは、お花の上ではねをとじました。{flower:face happy}{flower:hearts}あまくて、しあわせ。

de-DE.title: Der Schmetterling schmeckt mit den Füßen
de-DE.text: {butterfly:enter} Der Schmetterling suchte etwas Süßes. [curious] Wie merkt ein Schmetterling, ob etwas süß ist? Ganz einfach: Er landet darauf! {deer:enter} Das Reh stand in der Nähe und {deer:live graze} knabberte Gras. {butterfly:go on deer} Der Schmetterling {sfx:flutter} flatterte herunter, mitten auf den Kopf des Rehs. {deer:face surprised} Tipp, tipp, machten seine Füßchen. {butterfly:face sad} „Hm. Schmeckt nach Gras. Nicht süß.“ Da ploppte ein roter {mushroom:enter} Pilz aus dem Boden. {butterfly:go on mushroom} Der Schmetterling landete auf seinem Hut. Tipp, tipp. „Hm. Schmeckt nach Moos. Nicht süß.“ {mushroom:live laugh} [giggles] „Das kitzelt!“, sagte der Pilz. Und dort ging gerade eine gelbe {flower:enter} Blume auf. {butterfly:go on flower} Der Schmetterling landete mitten darin. Tipp, tipp… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:sparkle} [excited] {sfx:sip} „SÜSS!“ {deer:face normal} {deer:pulse} „Woher weißt du das?“, fragte das Reh. [whispers] „Ich hab’s geschmeckt“, sagte der Schmetterling, „mit meinen Füßen.“ {deer:face surprised} Da {deer:live tap-hoof} tippte das Reh mit dem Huf aufs Gras. Tipp, tipp. Gar nichts. {deer:face happy} Also {deer:live graze} knabberte es wie immer. „Mmh“, sagte es. „Schmeckt nach Gras. Genau wie ich’s mag.“ {butterfly:live rest hold} Und auf der Blume klappte der Schmetterling die Flügel zusammen. {flower:face happy} {flower:hearts} Süßer geht’s nicht.

fr-FR.title: Papillon goûte avec ses pattes
fr-FR.text: {butterfly:enter} Papillon cherchait quelque chose de sucré. [curious] Comment un papillon sait-il si c’est sucré ? Facile : il se pose dessus ! Tout près, {deer:enter} Faon {deer:live graze} broutait l’herbe du pré. {butterfly:go on deer} Papillon est descendu {sfx:flutter} en voletant, pile sur sa tête. {deer:face surprised} Tapoti, tapota, ont fait ses pattes. {butterfly:face sad} « Hum. Goût d’herbe. Pas sucré. » Hop, voilà un {mushroom:enter} champignon rouge. {butterfly:go on mushroom} Papillon s’est posé sur son chapeau. Tapoti, tapota. « Hum. Goût de mousse. Pas sucré. » {mushroom:live laugh} [giggles] « Ça chatouille ! » a dit Champignon. Et là, tout doucement, s’ouvrait une {flower:enter} fleur jaune. {butterfly:go on flower} Papillon s’est posé en plein milieu. Tapoti, tapota… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:sparkle} [excited] {sfx:sip} « SUCRÉ ! » {deer:face normal} {deer:pulse} « Comment tu le sais ? » a demandé Faon. [whispers] « Je l’ai goûté, a dit Papillon, avec mes pattes. » {deer:face surprised} Alors Faon {deer:live tap-hoof} a tapoté l’herbe avec son sabot. Tapoti, tapota. Rien du tout. {deer:face happy} Alors il {deer:live graze} l’a broutée comme d’habitude. « Mmm, a-t-il dit. Goût d’herbe. Comme je l’aime. » {butterfly:live rest hold} Et Papillon a replié ses ailes sur Fleur, {flower:face happy} {flower:hearts} la plus sucrée des fleurs.

it-IT.title: Farfalla assaggia con i piedini
it-IT.text: {butterfly:enter} Farfalla cercava qualcosa di dolce. [curious] Come fa una farfalla a sapere se una cosa è dolce? Facile. Ci si posa sopra! {deer:enter} Cerbiatto era lì vicino, nel prato, {deer:live graze} a brucare l'erba. {butterfly:go on deer} Farfalla è scesa {sfx:flutter} svolazzando, proprio sulla sua testa. {deer:face surprised} Tic, tic, hanno fatto i suoi piedini. {butterfly:face sad} «Mmm. Sa d'erba. Non è dolce.» Ed ecco spuntare un {mushroom:enter} fungo rosso. {butterfly:go on mushroom} Farfalla si è posata sul suo cappello. Tic, tic. «Mmm. Sa di muschio. Non è dolce.» {mushroom:live laugh} [giggles] «Che solletico!» ha detto Fungo. E lì accanto, che si stava aprendo, c'era un {flower:enter} fiore giallo. {butterfly:go on flower} Farfalla si è posata proprio nel mezzo. Tic, tic… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:sparkle} [excited] {sfx:sip} «DOLCE!» {deer:face normal} {deer:pulse} «Come fai a saperlo?» ha chiesto Cerbiatto. [whispers] «L'ho assaggiato», ha detto Farfalla, «con i piedini.» {deer:face surprised} Allora Cerbiatto {deer:live tap-hoof} ha toccato l'erba con lo zoccolo. Tic, tic. Niente di niente. {deer:face happy} Così l'ha {deer:live graze} brucata come al solito. «Mmm», ha detto. «Sa d'erba. Proprio come piace a me.» {butterfly:live rest hold} E Farfalla ha chiuso le ali su Fiore, {flower:face happy} {flower:hearts} dolce come il miele.

zh-TW.title: 蝴蝶用腳嚐味道
zh-TW.text: {butterfly:enter}蝴蝶在找甜甜的東西。[curious]蝴蝶怎麼知道一樣東西甜不甜呢？很簡單，停上去就知道了！{deer:enter}小鹿就在旁邊的草地上，{deer:live graze}低著頭吃草。{butterfly:go on deer}蝴蝶{sfx:flutter}輕輕飛下來，剛好停在牠的頭上。{deer:face surprised}小腳點、點。{butterfly:face sad}「嗯……草的味道。不甜。」 紅紅的{mushroom:enter}蘑菇冒了出來。{butterfly:go on mushroom}蝴蝶停在她的菇傘上。點、點。「嗯……青苔的味道。不甜。」 {mushroom:live laugh}[giggles]「好癢喔！」 蘑菇說。這時，旁邊有一朵黃色的{flower:enter}小花，正慢慢打開。{butterfly:go on flower}蝴蝶停在花的正中間。點、點……{butterfly:face happy}{butterfly:sparkle}[excited]{sfx:sip}「好甜！」 {deer:face normal}{deer:pulse}「你怎麼知道？」 小鹿問。[whispers]「我嚐過了，」 蝴蝶說，「用我的腳。」 {deer:face surprised}於是小鹿{deer:live tap-hoof}用蹄子點點草地。點、點。什麼味道也沒有。{deer:face happy}牠只好{deer:live graze}照平常那樣，大口吃草。「嗯……」 牠說，「草的味道，我最喜歡了。」 {butterfly:live rest hold}蝴蝶在小花上合起翅膀，{flower:face happy}{flower:hearts}一切都甜甜蜜蜜的。

zh-HK.title: 蝴蝶用腳試味
zh-HK.text: {butterfly:enter}蝴蝶正在找甜甜的東西。[curious]蝴蝶怎樣知道一樣東西甜不甜呢？很簡單，停上去就知道了！{deer:enter}小鹿就在附近的草地上，{deer:live graze}低頭吃着草。{butterfly:go on deer}蝴蝶{sfx:flutter}輕輕飛下來，剛好停在牠的頭上。{deer:face surprised}小腳嗒、嗒。{butterfly:face sad}「嗯……草味。唔甜。」 一朵紅色的{mushroom:enter}蘑菇冒了出來。{butterfly:go on mushroom}蝴蝶停在她的蘑菇帽上。嗒、嗒。「嗯……青苔味。都唔甜。」 {mushroom:live laugh}[giggles]「哈哈，好痕呀！」 蘑菇說。這時，旁邊有一朵黃色的{flower:enter}小花，正慢慢張開。{butterfly:go on flower}蝴蝶停在花的正中間。嗒、嗒……{butterfly:face happy}{butterfly:sparkle}[excited]{sfx:sip}「好甜呀！」 {deer:face normal}{deer:pulse}「你點知㗎？」 小鹿問。[whispers]「我試過味喇，」 蝴蝶說，「用腳試嘅。」 {deer:face surprised}於是小鹿{deer:live tap-hoof}用蹄子在草地上點了點。嗒、嗒。甚麼味道也沒有。{deer:face happy}牠只好{deer:live graze}像平常一樣，低頭吃草。「嗯……」 牠說，「草味，正呀！我最鍾意。」 {butterfly:live rest hold}蝴蝶在小花上合起翅膀，{flower:face happy}{flower:hearts}心裏甜得不得了。
